faq.q: What is the best AI fitness coach app?
faq.a: It depends on what you want coached. Fitbod is strongest for AI-generated strength workouts, Google Health Coach for all-round fitness and sleep with a Fitbit or Pixel Watch, and WHOOP Coach for recovery data if you wear a WHOOP. For losing weight through what you eat on iPhone, we recommend Fimbl, whose coach reads your meals, check-ins, mood, weigh-ins and activity.

faq.q: What is the best AI nutrition coach app?
faq.a: On iPhone, Fimbl is our pick if you want a coach that looks at why you eat as well as what, because it also knows your hunger and feelings at meals. MyFitnessPal Coach suits people who already use its food database, and Cronometer's Crono Coach suits people focused on vitamins, minerals and nutrient targets.

faq.q: What is the best AI coach for weight loss?
faq.a: Look for a coach that reads your food log and your weight. Fimbl does that on iPhone and iPad, alongside a photo calorie counter, a plan at a gentle pace and private progress photos. Noom is a good choice if you want a structured programme with a human coach in the US, and MacroFactor if you want your calorie targets adjusted automatically every week.

faq.q: Is there a free AI fitness coach?
faq.a: Most personal AI coaches are part of a paid plan, including those from Fimbl, MyFitnessPal, Cronometer and Google Health. Fimbl gives you your first weekly reflection and your first personal pattern for free. Noom says members keep access to Welli without its Premium tier, but Noom itself is a subscription. A general assistant like ChatGPT can answer fitness questions for free, but it mostly knows only what you tell it.

faq.q: Can ChatGPT replace a fitness coach?
faq.a: For general knowledge and simple plans, it can go a long way. It doesn't log your meals or workouts or follow up by itself, though, and it mostly knows only what you share. A dedicated coach has your data in front of it. Neither replaces a doctor, dietitian or qualified trainer when you have a medical condition or an injury.

faq.q: Is an AI coach as good as a human coach?
faq.a: Not for everything. An AI coach is available at any hour, cheaper and good at spotting patterns in your data, but research on AI coaching is still early, and a person is better at accountability, judgement and complex situations. Noom's US Premium tier combines both. If you have a medical condition or a history of disordered eating, please see a professional.

faq.q: Does Fimbl's coach make workout plans?
faq.a: No. Fimbl's coach focuses on eating, habits, mood and weight, and it can take your Apple Health activity into account if you allow it. For a training plan, Fitbod or Google Health Coach are better fits. Fimbl does have simple workout goals and reads your workouts from Apple Health.

faq.q: Does Fimbl train AI on my data?
faq.a: No. Fimbl doesn't train AI models on your data or sell it. When you ask the coach something, the request goes through Fimbl's servers to Google's Gemini API with only what the feature needs, and never your name, email, period days, Your story or progress photos. AI is optional, and everything else in Fimbl works without it.
